answer: A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 18 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a meadow bet on surviving 42 epochs of grading, and every vine settlement recomputes the pulse schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 42 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 37 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
